# recollection

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:processRecollection`](gmeow-processRecollection.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/processRecollection>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/mentation`](../../slices/mentation.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A recollection episode — retrieving a stored memory into present awareness (the act, not the stored content). Forgetting is modelled as suppression elsewhere, not as a process here.
